blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these show the associative property? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the identities that show the associative property.

blocks.text: Four plus seven, then plus three, equals four plus the quantity seven plus three. The order stays the same. Only the parentheses moved. That is associative.
Six plus y equals y plus six. The terms swap places. That is commutative, not associative.
Two times the quantity five times x equals the quantity two times five, times x. Same order, new grouping. Associative.
Careful with this one. The parentheses did not move. Inside them, x and two swapped places. That is commutative.
Three times the quantity x plus one equals three x plus three. That multiplies across a sum. It is distributive.
So two of them show the associative property: the numbers stay in the same order, and only the grouping changes.
